key.name: current-npub
key.description: The selected public identity; independent of Gnostr's active identity.

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.description: Reserved for a future notification service; disabled in this shell.

key.name: notification-privacy
key.description: One of hidden, sender, or preview; hidden is the privacy-preserving default.

key.name: sound-enabled
key.description: Reserved for a future notification service.

key.name: load-remote-images
key.description: Whether images linked from messages may be loaded without asking first. Off: nothing is fetched unless you load an image yourself, because loading it shows your IP address to its host unless you use Tor. Reserved; not used yet.

key.name: link-previews
key.description: Whether a link preview may be fetched without asking first. Off: nothing is fetched unless you ask for a preview of a message and confirm. Reserved; not used yet.

key.name: load-profile-pictures
key.description: Whether profile pictures are downloaded. Off, because fetching a picture shows your IP address to its host. Reserved; not used yet.

key.name: filter-unknown-senders
key.description: Messages from people you have not accepted go to Message Requests, with no profile lookup and hidden notifications, until you accept them. Reserved; not used yet.

key.name: show-message-previews
key.summary: Show message previews in the conversation list
key.description: Show the latest message text under each conversation in the list. Reserved; not used yet.

key.name: network-mode
key.description: system uses the desktop proxy settings, none connects directly, and tor uses the Tor SOCKS proxy at tor-socks-address and never falls back to a direct connection. Reserved: relay connections do not honour this setting or the desktop proxy settings yet.

key.name: tor-socks-address
key.description: host:port of the local Tor SOCKS5 proxy used when network-mode is tor. Reserved; not used yet.

key.name: discovery-relays
key.summary: Relays that locate the active account's relay lists
key.description: ws:// or wss:// relays asked for the selected account's own signed NIP-65 (kind 10002) and NIP-17 inbox (kind 10050) relay lists. Empty by default: Groundhog contacts no relay until one is configured.

key.name: signer-method
key.description: One of auto, local, nip46, or nip55l. For auto, local and nip55l, account-bound signing and NIP-44 use org.nostr.Signer; nip46 and message sending remain unsupported.

key.name: run-in-background
key.description: Keep receiving messages after the window is closed. Setup asks for this choice explicitly. Reserved; not used yet.

key.name: retention-days
key.description: Delete messages from this device after this many days; 0 keeps them. Reserved; not used yet.

key.name: default-disappearing-seconds
key.description: Expiration, in seconds, requested for messages in new conversations; 0 turns disappearing messages off. Reserved; not used yet.

key.name: enter-sends
key.description: Enter sends and Shift+Enter starts a new line; when off, Ctrl+Enter sends. Reserved; not used yet.

key.name: blossom-servers
key.description: Blossom servers that store encrypted attachments. Empty by default: attachments stay disabled until you choose a server. Reserved; not used yet.
